description:
Search Austrian state/provincial laws (Landesrecht).

Use this tool to find laws enacted by Austrian federal states (Bundeslaender).

Search strategy: "titel" and "paragraph" (together with "bundesland") are the precise
entry points — prefer them whenever the law or the section is known. "suchworte" runs a
broad full-text search and the RIS API returns those hits ordered alphabetically by law
title, not by relevance, so a common term buries the relevant law under thousands of
results. Austrian law often splits one topic across several statutes and across the
federal/state divide — when the topic turns out to be federal rather than state law
(warranty, for example, sits in the VGG and in §§ 922 ff ABGB), search it with
ris_bundesrecht instead.

Example queries:
  - suchworte="Bauordnung", bundesland="Salzburg" -> Find state building law
  - titel="Bauordnung", bundesland="Wien", paragraph="1" -> Specific section
  - suchworte="Naturschutz", bundesland="Tirol", fassung_vom="2020-01-01" -> Version as of a date

abschnitt_typ.description: Type of section that "paragraph" refers to: "Paragraph" (default), "Artikel", or "Anlage" (annex).

bundesland.description: Filter by state - Wien, Niederoesterreich, Oberoesterreich, Salzburg, Tirol, Vorarlberg, Kaernten, Steiermark, Burgenland

fassung_vom.description: Consolidated version as of this date (YYYY-MM-DD) — retrieves the law text as it stood on that day.

gesetzesnummer.description: Exact law number (Gesetzesnummer) for a specific state law

limit.description: Results per page: 10, 20, 50 or 100 (default: 20). Every hit costs about 1k characters of structured payload, so prefer 20 for browsing and 50 for a broad survey; a page that would exceed the payload budget is delivered at the next smaller page size and says so (page_size, query.limit and notice).

paragraph.description: Section number to search for (e.g., "1" for §1, "7" for Art 7)

suchworte.description: Broad full-text search terms. Hits come back ordered alphabetically by law title, not by relevance — prefer "titel" and/or "paragraph" whenever the law or the section is known.

name: ris_landesrecht

citation_display.description: Preformatted citation line as shown in the text output

entscheidungsdatum.description: Decision date as YYYY-MM-DD (Judikatur documents only)

gericht.description: Deciding court or authority (Judikatur documents only)

geschaeftszahl.description: Case number(s), semicolon-separated when several (Judikatur documents only)

rechtssatznummer.description: Rechtssatz number, e.g. "RS0018547" (Judikatur Rechtssatz documents only)

has_more.description: Whether further result pages are available

notice.description: Present when the page was delivered at a smaller size than requested to fit the payload budget — page, page_size and query already describe the delivered page; page with query.limit

page.description: Page number of this result set (1-based)

query.description: Echo of the validated search parameters alongside the tool name — re-issue the call with an incremented "seite" for the next page

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result — call it again to paginate

total_hits.description: Total number of documents in RIS matching the search

title: Landesrecht durchsuchen
